entry.name: attrui
entry.description: Use attrui object to inspect the attribute values of the object(s) it is connected to.

choices.digest: Display is based on the attribute style
choices.label: In Automatic mode,configures the display based on the style of the attribute. For example, a color attribute shows a color editor or a toggle attribute shows a checkbox.

choices.digest: Display is always a single number
choices.label: In Single Number (int) mode, the attribute is always shown as a single number in a number-box style. This is appropriate for showing only one attribute whose type is. You can restrictto show a single attribute using theattribute.

choices.digest: Display is always a single number
choices.label: In Single Number (float) mode, the attribute is always shown as a single number in a number-box style. This is appropriate for showing only one attribute whose type is. You can restrictto show a single attribute using theattribute.
In Multi Number (int) mode, the attribute is always represented with multiple int number boxes.
In Multi Number (float) mode, the attribute is always represented with multiple float number boxes.

choices.digest: Display is always a list text field
choices.label: In List mode, the attribute is always shown in a textfield you can change by typing.

choices.digest: Display is always a color picker
